parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the approval process. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces. Chinese characters are supported.

parameters.name: ProcessId
parameters.description: The ID of the approval process.

parameters.name: ProcessName
parameters.description: The name of the approval process. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported.

parameters.name: ProcessNodes
parameters.description: The list of approval nodes. You can define up to 5 approval nodes.
